title: ProjectManifest
description: The 'introduce yourself' contract. A host project declares its objective, constraints, and evaluator ownership. KAV reads this before doing anything. Law 1: the evaluator is sovereign — this schema contains declarations only, never access.

project_id.description: Stable unique identifier. Immutable once registered.

schema_version.description: Version of this contract the host implements.

description.description: What the host system does and what question R&D should answer.

metric.description: The ONE trusted metric name, as reported by the host's evaluator. Law 1: KAV never computes this value itself.

direction.description: Whether improvement means higher or lower.

baseline.description: Current champion score, if known. Optional; KAV treats null as 'unknown'.

max_budget_per_experiment.description: Hard limits every ExperimentSpec must respect (Law 2). At least one limit required in practice; enforced by KAV validation.

forbidden_actions.description: Explicit list of things KAV may never request (e.g. 'touch_validation_set', 'change_features_schema').

owned_by.description: Always 'host'. Law 1 made structural: there is no field anywhere in the contract that grants KAV evaluator access.

description.description: Documentation of how measurement works, for hypothesis quality. Informational only.
